Manual SSH Key Setup Instructions for VPS 161.97.112.146

1. Connect to your VPS using VNC:
   VNC: 5.189.145.177:63162

2. Once connected via VNC, open a terminal and run these commands:

   # Create .ssh directory if it doesn't exist
   mkdir -p ~/.ssh
   
   # Set proper permissions
   chmod 700 ~/.ssh
   
   # Create or edit authorized_keys file
   nano ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
   
3. Copy and paste the following public key into the authorized_keys file:

ssh-rsa  trae-vps

4. Save the file (Ctrl+X, then Y, then Enter in nano)

5. Set proper permissions on authorized_keys:
   chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

6. Test the SSH connection from your local machine:
   ssh -i ./d root@161.97.112.146

Alternatively, you can use the following one-liner via VNC terminal:
echo 'ssh-rsa  trae-vps' >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 700 ~/.ssh
